snippet.title: Qubes (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/qubes/id1033020671

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.qubes

Tap to change the direction of the bouncing ball. Collect coins and unlock new balls.

How long can you survive on the qubes?
